binding.actor_view_hash: SHA-256 of principal-scoped actor view (ADAPTER_OWNED hash, no hidden leakage; same view => same hash; different state/principal => different hash)
binding.frame_digest: SHA-256(game_id, revision, actor_id, subject_id, decision_kind, option_digest, actor_view_hash) (ADAPTER_OWNED; binds all required)
binding.game_identity: game.getId() ENGINE_NATIVE + protocol game_id; bound in decision_id + frame_digest
binding.option_digest: SHA-256(options, kind, sorted external option ids) (ADAPTER_OWNED; binds current authoritative option identities)
binding.principal: actor_id + subject_id ENGINE_NATIVE (decisionAuthority via ledger); bound in decision_id + frame_digest + explicit wrong-actor rejection
binding.relevant_frame_state_identity: decisionOffset + actorViewHash + option set (ADAPTER_OWNED digests; no second Rules engine; envelope material only)

descriptive_caution: Adapter digests/revisions are described ONLY as ADAPTER_OWNED envelope freshness, never as XMage-native tokens. decision_id/frame_digest are CPL stable hashes, not engine UUIDs.
evidence_class: DIRECTLY_VERIFIED (runtime digests + rejections) + CODE_DERIVED (provenance map in code) + TECHNICALLY_CONFORMANT (bounded PASS)
leakage: PASS (digests are SHA-256 hex, no names/UUIDs; provenance contains no identities; full frame for actor contains no opponent private name; see M4 + freshness-leak test)
mechanism: Per-frame adapter digests computed at request time from current engine-issued option set + actor view hash; submit must echo all three (frame_digest/option_digest/revision) exactly; mismatch => STALE_DECISION; missing => PILOT_RESPONSE_INVALID. Strongest conformant without a second Rules engine (no state hash from engine internals, only envelope binding of engine-issued material).
older_frame: PASS (replayed consumed frame => STALE; previous-frame exact response against new frame => STALE; tampered digest => STALE; missing => INVALID; see Ws56StateFreshnessTest.olderFrameResponseFailsClosed + m3 matrix)
